idle: She stands in a relaxed fencing stance with the rapier tip low and forward and her left hand drawn back, breathing slowly. Her feet stay planted on the same spot.
turn: She stands exactly as in <Picture 1> in a relaxed fencing stance with the rapier tip low and forward and her left hand drawn back. After a moment she slowly pivots on the spot with the mannequin, her whole body and the rapier turning together, then stands still in the relaxed stance again. Her feet stay on the same spot.
run: From the relaxed stance she swings the rapier back behind her, reaches her empty left hand out ahead of her and breaks into a sprint, exactly as the mannequin does. She sprints flat out with long bounding strides, her torso leaning well forward with her left shoulder leading. Her right arm stays out behind her holding the rapier, and the blade points backward and down behind her: from then on the rapier is never in front of her. Each front knee drives up under the skirt, each back leg stretches out fully behind her, both feet leave the ground between strides. Her hair, skirt and tail stream out behind her. She runs on the spot and does not travel across the frame.
dash: She drops low and glides forward in a fast low slide with her torso leaning far forward and the rapier held out in front, then brakes with her back foot and rises back into the relaxed stance. She stays in the same place in the frame.
light1: From a relaxed stance she winds back with her left hand reaching forward, then drives into one long deep lunge: the right foot steps far forward, the right arm stretches to its full length along the exact path of the sword in the video and the left arm flings back behind her. She holds the lunge for a moment, then her back foot catches up into the relaxed stance, further forward in the frame exactly as the mannequin does.
flurry: From a relaxed stance she winds back, then drives into a long lunge and makes four big quick thrusts in a row, the right arm stretching to full length and drawing right back for each one, level, high, low, and the fourth the deepest, with the left arm flung back behind her and the rapier following the exact path of the sword in the video. She holds the last one for a moment, then her back foot catches up into the relaxed stance, further forward in the frame exactly as the mannequin does.
cast: From a relaxed stance she lowers the rapier to her right side and raises her empty left hand high with an open palm as if presenting a seal, her gaze lifted. She holds this pose steadily, then lowers the hand and returns to the relaxed stance on the same spot.
charge: From a relaxed stance she sinks low and winds far back, the rapier drawn beside her head and her left hand aimed straight ahead, and holds that charged pose. Then she explodes forward in one huge charging lunge that carries her far across the frame, the right arm at full stretch, the left arm flung back. She holds it for a moment, then her back foot catches up into the relaxed stance, far forward in the frame exactly as the mannequin does.
dash_attack: From a relaxed stance she drops low into a fast forward glide, then without stopping thrusts straight ahead in one long lunge with the rapier arm at full stretch and her left arm flung back. She holds the lunge for a moment, then steps her back foot up and rises into the relaxed stance where she landed.
summon: From a relaxed stance she lowers the rapier to her right side and lifts her empty left hand in front of her chest with the palm open and turned up, as if presenting something on it, her gaze on the hand. She holds this pose steadily, then lowers the hand and returns to the relaxed stance on the same spot.
interact: From a relaxed stance she lowers the rapier to her right side, leans forward a little and reaches out with her empty left hand as if touching something at waist height in front of her. She holds this pose steadily, then straightens up and returns to the relaxed stance on the same spot.
hit: She is struck: her upper body jerks backward and her weight rocks onto her back foot, her arms thrown slightly open, keeping hold of the rapier. Then she recovers and settles back into the relaxed stance on the same spot.
death: She is struck and reels backward, then her strength leaves her: she sinks down onto one knee with the rapier tip dropping to the ground and her head falling forward, and slowly slumps further with her shoulders low and her hair falling forward. She stays down, motionless, until the end of the clip.
revive: She starts slumped on one knee with her head down and the rapier tip on the ground. She slowly lifts her head, draws the rapier up, pushes herself up off the knee and rises to her feet, settling into the relaxed stance on the same spot.
run_start: From the relaxed stance she drops her weight low, then drives off into one long running stride with her torso leaning in, her left hand reaching ahead and the rapier trailing behind her. She does this on the same spot, without moving through the frame, and holds the stride until the end of the clip.
run_stop: She comes out of a long running stride with the rapier trailing behind her, plants her front foot, swings the rapier forward and settles into the relaxed stance, her skirt and hair swinging on for a moment after she stops. She does this on the same spot, without moving through the frame.
knockdown: She is struck hard and reels backward, drops onto one knee, then slumps low with her head down and the rapier tip on the ground beside her. She stays down, motionless, until the end of the clip.
get_up: She starts slumped on one knee with her head down and the rapier tip on the ground. She lifts her head, draws the rapier up, pushes off the knee and rises briskly to her feet, settling into the relaxed stance on the same spot.
victory: From the relaxed stance she raises the rapier straight up in front of her in a fencer's salute, the blade exactly upright with the tip up and her left hand behind her back. She holds it, bows her head a little, lifts it again, then slowly lowers the rapier back to the relaxed stance on the same spot.
